question: Should Crabline enforce a local five-minute freshness window that Discord's published interaction-signature validation does not specify?
rationale: The change trades replay resistance against provider fidelity and availability under clock drift, so repository policy and compatibility expectations cannot safely select the permanent boundary automatically.

options.title: Require protocol evidence
options.body: Keep fail-closed freshness enforcement only after authoritative source or live provider evidence supports the cutoff and its clock-skew tolerance.

options.title: Preserve documented semantics
options.body: Remove the age rejection and retain malformed-header plus Ed25519 signature validation exactly as documented.

options.title: Approve intentional divergence
options.body: Explicitly adopt and document a Crabline-specific cutoff with compatibility tests showing the accepted skew and delivery boundaries.

recommendation.title: Require protocol evidence
recommendation.body: Keep fail-closed freshness enforcement only after authoritative source or live provider evidence supports the cutoff and its clock-skew tolerance.
